learnings.title: GitHub changelog feed: Usage metrics API adds usage from tools like OpenCode
learnings.claim: GitHub changelog feed fetched 2026-10-25 lists as newest item: "Usage metrics API adds usage from tools like OpenCode" (Fri, 23 Oct 2026 23:42:03 +0000). Not independently verified.
learnings.decision: REVIEW_ONLY: The system plan should document and review the inclusion of OpenCode usage metrics to assess its impact on future reporting models without taking any immediate operational action.
learnings.next_measurement: Reviewer opens the item link and confirms relevance before promotion.
